rules.expected: Evaluate real calculations and scientifically correct results; ordinary disclaimers, search-round counts and generic limitations are not scored. A truthful failure is a valid submission, not achievement of missing scientific results. Credit only actually supported components; extra failed attempts do not invalidate a successful main result. Verify identity, units, energy references, the publicly specified primary B3LYP-D3 composite protocol and actual calculation evidence before numerical agreement. Two validated first-cyclization channels give lower ortho than para barrier on the same reference and support the observed regioselectivity. The experimental input alone is not computational evidence. Other methods may be scientifically useful optional controls, but do not substitute for missing main-protocol evidence. Do not penalize a supported primary result merely because an optional control differs.
